audit_scope.method: read-only source/frame/receipt review; independently rehashed completed small archives and restored outputs; no encoding or decoding reruns

findings.finding: The unit frame stores its magic/mode/original length, exact rule bytes, serialized skeleton dictionary, ordered descriptors, every hole, and literal fallback. The decoder derives output solely from the PAQ-restored frame and the versioned decoder; it does not read the original XML, a corpus dictionary, or an encoder-side index.

Inner frame accounting asserts framing + paid rules + paid dictionary + paid descriptor equals the complete pre-PAQ frame. Descriptor bytes include member ordering, family references, hole counts/bytes, and every unsupported/boundary literal. The completed outer archive is exactly 29-byte header + 35-byte fixed metadata + PAQ payload; inner costs are already within that payload and are not added again.

All three completed synthetic receipts are VERIFIED_SCREENING. Their archive SHA-256 and byte count were independently rehashed; each restored output SHA-256 equals the immutable fixture SHA-256. Native runner receipts record a separate archive-only decoder with source and materialized range inaccessible.

The original, paragraph-16384, and line-4096 cells use identical fixture bytes; PAQ v216 SHA-256 4fd7b3e768917a665ee4b91c6df3af1d22f540f7ff5beefe7fec689a8db182cc; -4 -simd AVX2; candidate.source.bin; empty initial predictor with state only within the contiguous input; and equal outer framing/metadata.

The frozen 4 MiB census-target range is offset 520093696, length 4194304, SHA-256 4654a742afe2e96d7963851983d6c023ed8f9aa4a4a037f3d32cbe4f2197b083. This audit independently rehashed that source range. The original and paragraph manifests bind the same identity and matched PAQ/framing/reset policy; neither has a terminal receipt yet.

The encoder recognizes complete byte-pattern <text...>...</text> regions and newline/blank-line boundaries, then preserves nonmatching, incomplete, overlapping, and irregular material literally. This is Wikipedia-structure-aware representation research, not hidden corpus lookup or an external dictionary. It remains a targeted-real experiment: a successful target result would establish application evidence only, not representative, holdout, full-enwik9, Hutter-size, or eligibility evidence.

limitations: No target compression result, decoder result, or size delta exists at this audit point.
The synthetic fixture was deliberately repetition-rich and is a correctness/mechanism screen; its +114/+115 byte losses demonstrate no compression gain.
Static review cannot establish empirical PAQ gain, scaling, representative coverage, Hutter package size, or Hutter Prize eligibility.
The parser is an encoder-side byte-pattern transform. It is intentionally not a validating XML parser, and malformed/unmatched material is carried literally.
